description: This file defines FastAPI endpoints for managing vector stores within a larger AI/ML infrastructure. It includes CRUD operations such as creating, listing, deleting, retrieving info, and updating vector stores, interacting with both in-memory registries and a persistent database through Prisma. The endpoints are organized with FastAPI's APIRouter and use dependency injection for authentication and database connections.

classes.name: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStoresTable
classes.description: Data model representing vector store metadata for API responses or internal operations.

classes.name: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStore
classes.description: Internal representation of a managed vector store, used for registry and response purposes.

classes.name: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStoreListResponse
classes.description: Response model for listing multiple vector stores with pagination info.

classes.name: VectorStoreDeleteRequest
classes.description: Request model for deleting a vector store by ID.

classes.name: VectorStoreInfoRequest
classes.description: Request model for fetching information about a specific vector store.

classes.name: VectorStoreUpdateRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating vector store details.

classes.name: UserAPIKeyAuth
classes.description: Authentication dependency for user API key validation.

methods.name: new_vector_store( vector_store: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStore, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Creates a new vector store, adds it to the database and in-memory registry.

methods.name: list_vector_stores( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), page: int = 1, page_size: int = 100, )
methods.description: Lists all vector stores with pagination, synchronizing in-memory and database state.

methods.name: delete_vector_store( data: VectorStoreDeleteRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Deletes a vector store from database and registry by ID.

methods.name: get_vector_store_info( data: VectorStoreInfoRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific vector store, from registry or database.

methods.name: update_vector_store( data: VectorStoreUpdateRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Updates properties of an existing vector store in the database and registry.

ctags.name: list_vector_stores
ctags.signature: ( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), page: int = 1, page_size: int = 100, )
